_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27), second read. Contra Costa 33660 (Physical Education/Kinesiology A.S.) holds because its notes quote the unit summary's general education rows ('None', 'N/A') and say nothing of its electives row, so degree_summary_ge_none's sentence (general education and electives as None or N/A) is not shown on its own words. This read prints the page as the capture reads it, so a session can read the Unit Summary's rows word for word. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.unit_summary: Every row of the page's Unit Summary (major, general education local, CSU/IGETC, electives, total program), word for word.
